name: Masters of the Universe: Tales from Eternia
original_name: Masters of the Universe: Tales from Eternia
overview: The series introduces a new generation of young fans to the iconic world of Masters of the Universe through fast-paced, action-packed mini adventures. Tales from Eternia delivers high-stakes clashes between He-Man, Skeletor, and Eternia's iconic heroes and villains, bringing the timeless conflict between good and evil to life for today's audiences.
